name: Brand of Truth
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [curse, mind-affecting]; Level cleric 3, inquisitor 2, oracle 3, paladin 3, warpriest 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 round
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration 1 day/level
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

This spell etches a symbol of justice, light, order or truth on the target’s body, dealing 1d6 points of damage. The mark can be placed on any exposed portion of the creature, typically on the head or forearm. A creature branded in this way cannot speak any deliberate and intentional lies, though it may avoid answering questions to which it would normally respond with a lie, or it may be evasive as long as it remains within the boundaries of the truth. A brand of truth can be hidden by clothing or removed by scraping the brand away (the latter deals 1d6 points of damage, though the brand returns if that damage is healed), but in either case the effects of a brand of truth continue to function.
